Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list. Short answers here and I can get tech docs across plus a one-page summary for legal.

1) Exportability: yes — we support bulk exports of audit logs and request traces. Standard formats: NDJSON, zipped CSV bundles, and compressed parquet for large datasets. Exports include a delivery manifest with SHA256 digests and per-file timestamps. Typical turnaround depends on size and required tamper-evidence: 24–72 hours for <200GB; for multi-hundred-GB we coordinate a delivery window and S3 staging (can be 3–7 days).

2) Retention windows: tenant-level configurable up to 10 years; minimum retention is 7 days. You can set policies per record class (auth, request-trace, model-invoke metadata). We also support exportable archived tiers (cold storage) for long-term preservation.

3) Chain of custody: we provide signed manifests, and optional notarized timestamps on request. We maintain an evidence-handoff runbook for eDiscovery with verification steps.

4) Redaction/PII: we offer export-time redaction templates (regex + named-entity lists) as part of our Audit Export add-on; for bespoke redaction we can run filtered exports or provide tooling and sample redaction policies.

I'll loop in our tech lead (cc'd internally) to add detail and attach the RFP checklist and SOC2 summary. Would Thursday 6/17 at 10:00am PT work for a 30-minute call?

Best,

Kimberly — quick technical notes for the RFP response. See inline answers and attached samples.

1) Export formats / turnaround:
- We can produce NDJSON (line-delimited JSON), CSV bundles, Parquet (snappy) for analytics lakes. For >200GB we stage to a pre-signed S3 bucket; typical orchestration time is 48–96 hours depending on peak load and retention-tier retrieval times.

2) Manifest & tamper evidence:
- Manifest fields: filename, record_count, first_timestamp, last_timestamp, sha256, gz_size_bytes, record_class.
- We generate a signed manifest (RSA-2048 signature) and can append a notarized timestamp (RFC 3161) as an add-on. Notarization adds ~24 hours.

3) Retention policy:
- Configurable per-record-class via tenant policy. Min 7d, max 10y. Cold tiers can be archived to a customer-owned S3 location on request.

4) Redaction:
- We support server-side export-time redaction using configured regex and NER lists. Two modes: suppress (remove fields) or mask (replace). For PII-heavy exports we recommend masking + review.

Attachments included in this reply: audit_export_playbook.pdf, redwood_audit_schema_v1.csv, schema_samples.ndjson

Let me know if you want a trimmed one-pager for legal; I can produce an export SLA blurb and chain-of-custody checklist.
